title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wpmet…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in ElementsKit Elementor addons Lite (up to version 4.1.0). This vulnerability is due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which could allow an attacker with low privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of the affected web application.
